title: Finance Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities Manage end-to-end accounting, including bookkeeping, journal entries and general ledger maintenance. Process vendor invoices and payments under Accounts Payable, and carry out regular vendor reconciliations. Manage customer receipts and outstanding follow-up under Accounts Receivable, and carry out customer reconciliations. Handle bank transactions, payments and fund transfers, and prepare monthly bank reconciliations. Ensure statutory compliance for GST (GSTR-1, GSTR-2B, GSTR-3B, refunds), TDS (monthly payments and quarterly returns), PF and ESI. Validate payroll data and support monthly salary processing and documentation. Prepare monthly MIS reports covering payables, receivables, expenses, cash flow and cost analysis for management review. Carry out month-end and year-end closing, ledger scrutiny, trial balance checks, and accruals, provisions and prepaid entries. Coordinate with internal and external auditors, and provide schedules and supporting records for audit finalization. Support ROC/MCA filings and financial statement preparation as per Schedule III of the Companies Act, 2013. Liaise with vendors, customers, banks, consultants and internal teams on finance-related matters. Preferred candidate profile Education: B.Com, BBA, BCA or M.Com. An MBA (Finance) or a pursuing SAP FICO certification is a plus. Experience: 4 to 8 years in Finance & Accounts, with a Senior Executive or Senior Accountant designation preferred. Core skills: Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, bank reconciliation, general ledger, GST, TDS, PF/ESI and month-end closing. Software: Strong working knowledge of Tally ERP 9 / TallyPrime and advanced MS Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables). Exposure to Zoho Books, SAP or other ERPs is an advantage. Industry exposure: Manufacturing, logistics, software services, pharma or apparel preferred. Soft skills: Strong follow-up and time management Ability to coordinate with auditors and stakeholders Attention to detail and a problem-solving approach Adaptable to changing systems and processes Notice period: Immediate joiners or up to 30 days preferred. Perks and benefits Competitive salary, based on experience and interview performance Provident Fund (PF) and ESI as applicable Paid leave and public holidays Performance-based incentives and annual appraisal Learning support for certifications such as SAP FICO and advanced Excel Exposure to multiple industries and statutory work Growth path toward Assistant Manager / Finance Manager roles Supportive team and stable work

Key Skills: FICO,Finance,Funds flow management,Budgeting,ERP,Finance control,Management,Auditing
